text.text: our process

text.html: To ensure the best experience during your shoot, and to optimize Hotel guest experience, the following guidelines apply for professional shoots:
text.text: To ensure the best experience during your shoot, and to optimize Hotel guest experience, the following guidelines apply for professional shoots:

text.html: Upon receiving the requirements of your shoot (including the day/date/time), the Hotel will check availability and provide a list of available spaces where the photographer can shoot/film.
text.text: Upon receiving the requirements of your shoot (including the day/date/time), the Hotel will check availability and provide a list of available spaces where the photographer can shoot/film.

text.html: Room rental charges may apply (in addition to the location fee) to reserve spaces to shoot in.
text.text: Room rental charges may apply (in addition to the location fee) to reserve spaces to shoot in.

text.html: A Hotel team member will be available to you throughout the shoot and will provide entrance to the pre-determined available areas of the Hotel. As a result, a location flat fee of $500 will apply.
text.text: A Hotel team member will be available to you throughout the shoot and will provide entrance to the pre-determined available areas of the Hotel. As a result, a location flat fee of $500 will apply.

text.html: Shooting in public areas of the Hotel (including, but not limited to front steps, The Lobby Bar, The Lobby Terrace, Pool Lounge, Zuma) are not guaranteed, and may be limited.
text.text: Shooting in public areas of the Hotel (including, but not limited to front steps, The Lobby Bar, The Lobby Terrace, Pool Lounge, Zuma) are not guaranteed, and may be limited.

text.html: The content of the shoot will need to be approved by the Hotel with a signed Letter of Agreement, and Event Order.
